text:
Emma Nguyen: Uploading external pen-test artifacts (ACME POC) to S3 for review. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/ — public link restricted, shareable URL will follow. Attached: nessus-report.xml, burp-session.zip, exploit-proof.jpg

Alex Chen: Thanks. Can you confirm checksums and bucket encryption/KMS key? Also need asset mapping spreadsheet.

Emma Nguyen: Yes — bucket encrypted with customer-managed KMS (alias/redwood-acme-kms). Checksums below and full list in s3.

```
# s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/manifest.txt
essus-report.xml  d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
burp-session.zip   3b5d5c3712955042212316173ccf37be
exploit-proof.jpg   9e107d9d372bb6826bd81d3542a419d6
```

Samir Patel: Ran quick triage on the vuln list. Two findings marked CRITICAL (priv escalation CVE-2024-1234) and HIGH (auth bypass CVE-2024-5678). I can prepare hotfix container and a rollback plan.

Maria Lopez: Customer legal asked for evidence checksum + remediation timeline before the next exec demo. We should confirm signoff process.

Alex Chen: Proposed timeline: Critical: patch & canary deploy in 72h, full rollout after verification (<=5d). High: patch + staging validation in 10 business days. Medium/low: scheduled in normal release cycle (TBD). Copied legal for signoff.

Emma Nguyen: Assigning owners: @Alex Chen -> patch review + canary; @Samir Patel -> staging deploy and rollback playbook; @Emma Nguyen -> evidence bundle & S3 access token for customer.

SecurityBot: Scan ingestion completed — 48 findings found. Severity breakdown: Critical:2, High:7, Medium:23, Low:16. Report ID: SB-2026-ACME-1845

Samir Patel: Rollback plan draft:
1) Disable new service route via proxy
2) Repoint traffic to previous image tag: redwood/service:2026-02-11
3) Revoke temporary credentials and rotate KMS if compromise suspected
I'll attach playbook to the ticket.

Alex Chen: QA verification steps (short):
- Re-run nessus quick scan on staging
- Run smoke tests for login/kv-store access
- Confirm KV cache integrity

Maria Lopez: Customer asked if we can provide signed hash file for legal. @Emma Nguyen can you confirm PGP/signature?

Emma Nguyen: Will sign the manifest with our org GPG key and upload signed-manifest.asc to s3 by EOD tomorrow.

Samir Patel: Note: we found one flaky replication edge during testing — mitigation is config flag flip; low risk but we'll include in release notes.

Alex Chen: FYI, we'll hold POC demo until critical findings verified on canary. ETA for reschedule: ~1 week after canary verification.

Maria Lopez: Confirmed. I'll notify the customer and ask for acceptance criteria for "verified".

Emma Nguyen: Upload paths:
- s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/nessus-report.xml
- s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/burp-session.zip
- s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/manifest.txt
- s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/signed-manifest.asc
Commands to fetch (internal):
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/manifest.txt - | sha256sum
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-poc/burp-session.zip ./ && sha256sum burp-session.zip
```

Alex Chen: I'll create JIRA: SEC-4231 (critical), SEC-4232 (highs grouped). Assigning @Samir Patel and adding labels: pen-test, acme-poc, expedited.

SecurityBot: Evidence bundle archived to Glacier-Deep (retention=180d). Access audit log created. Audit ID: AUD-2026-5512

Maria Lopez: Thanks everyone. Please add any blockers here. Customer asked for contact for SOC call — @Alex Chen will be the primary.

Samir Patel: No blockers from infra. I need a quick permission for temporary elevated IAM to run the hotfix (I'll request via access request).

Emma Nguyen: Granting temporary role for 72h once ticket is created. Will post the request link.

Alex Chen: A couple of quick notes for legal: we'll provide:
- signed-manifest.asc
- S3 pre-signed URLs (7 days)
- remediation timeline & Jira links

Maria Lopez: Perfect. :white_check_mark: I'll prepare the email template to ACME and share draft here.

Emma Nguyen: Draft uploaded: https://docs.google.com/draft/acme-pt-email (internal link)

Maria Lopez: Great — closing the loop. Ping me if anything slips. :eyes:
